caveat: frozen for implementation, NOT mentor approval; subject to independent numerical review before final runs

comparators.EXACT: bitwise equality of parsed double or text line; no tolerance
comparators.INVARIANT: sign, bound, monotonicity, saturation shape, or count
comparators.TOLERANCE: relative difference against a threshold stated in this contract or AGENTS.md; never introduced or widened after an outcome is seen

conclusion_rule.if_any_contradictory_or_inconclusive: the conclusion must name it and must not claim overall support for P07
may_not_state: any conservation property of the model as a whole
may_state: which defect mappings are REPRODUCED and REPAIR_VERIFIED
that no observed difference is platform-attributable

determinism: comparison record must be byte-identical under any input ordering; comparator sorts by canonical key and the synthetic suite verifies by shuffling

dimensions.contradictory_when: repaired exceeds available, or baseline saturates while repaired does not
dimensions.name: CDEF-01/02 second-half donor cap
dimensions.observable: fluid-side A_particles and A_fluid over the k1 sweep
dimensions.repair_verified_when: repaired saturates (constant within 1e-6 relative for rows with alpha_prime>1) AND A_particles_final == fA0*V_cell exactly
dimensions.reproduced_when: baseline transfer grows monotonically with k1 (not capped)

dimensions.inconclusive_when: they differ but no branch execution was observed
dimensions.name: CDEF-03 first-half stale exchange area
dimensions.observable: particle cA, cC after a tip growth step
dimensions.repair_verified_when: trees differ on a fixture where a tip growth branch is directly observed to execute

dimensions.contradictory_when: predicted and observed branches disagree on any transition
dimensions.name: CDEF-04 tip stored-area staleness
dimensions.repair_verified_when: additionally repaired cA/cC differ from baseline on those fixtures
dimensions.reproduced_when: both branches execute in baseline with stored area left bit-unchanged on every transition

dimensions.name: CDEF-05 non-tip rejected-growth rollback
dimensions.observable: particle cB, vol, dvdt, dadt on non-tip segments
dimensions.repair_verified_when: rejections observed AND repaired cB restored while baseline cB remains debited

dimensions.name: carbon-only scope preserved
dimensions.observable: 91 phosphorus-bearing source lines and diff scope
dimensions.unchanged_invariant_when: all 91 P-lines byte-identical and the patch touches exactly one file

dimensions.name: phosphorus excluded from claims
dimensions.observable: claim text of this stage's report
dimensions.unchanged_invariant_when: no conclusion asserts phosphorus correctness and the dP1/dP2 asymmetry is restated

dimensions.name: source/build/executable identity continuity
dimensions.observable: baseline and candidate commits and kernel hashes, AMReX commit and tree, four image SHA-256s, per-image provenance
dimensions.unchanged_invariant_when: every identity matches the frozen value and every image reports RESOLVED provenance on a clean tree

dimensions.derives_from: spec synthetic branch: platform-only difference incorrectly classified as repair effect
dimensions.inconclusive_when: fewer than two platforms available for the same tree
dimensions.name: platform-only differences not attributed to P07
dimensions.observable: same-tree observables across all platforms exercised
dimensions.platform_comparison_class: a difference may be attributed to P07 ONLY when it appears between baseline and repaired WITHIN a single platform; a difference for the SAME tree ACROSS platforms is platform-only and may never be attributed to the repair
dimensions.unchanged_invariant_when: cross-platform variance is zero for each tree

protection: every rule derives from the five reviewed P07 defect mappings (CDEF-01..05) and AGENTS.md tolerances, which predate the observations
no rule references a numeric value taken from an observed outcome
every outcome class is exercised by synthetic fixtures independent of the real data
